articleTitle: Implementation of Hand Gesture Based Home Automation Using Haar Cascading Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced & Global Engineering Challenges (AGEC)
abstract: Home automation is a crucial requirement for today's generation because it supports those with disabilities and the elderly. With the use of hand gesture recognition, home appliances can be controlled more easily than remote controlled home appliances. Under the branch of Human Computer Interaction (HCI), hand gesture recognition systems take images as input and mechanical work as output. This proposed system does real-time image processing for hand gesture identification. The Haar Cascading technique is utilized to process the image, while KNN algorithm is employed for gesture recognition. The experimental results suggest that the proposed method has achieved improved performance as compared to some of the other methods.

articleTitle: PV and Wind Distributed Generation System Power Quality Improvement Based on Modular UPQC
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced & Global Engineering Challenges (AGEC)
abstract: Today reliability and power quality are the two terms which are influencing the economic growth of any country. The current variations are one such power quality issue which affects power system. The root cause of these current variations as harmonics is due to the intensified usage of nonlinear loads. Active power conditioners can reduce current harmonics (SAPFs, SEAPFs, UPQCs, IPQCs). To be more specific, SAPF consists of a DC synchronizing Capacitor and a voltage source converter. In voltage source converters, the power semiconductor devices are switched using a Hysteresis Band Current Controller (HBCC). Series reactive current (SRC) injection is used for voltage compensation, and a proposal for using power quality (PQ) theory to produce reference currents to inject at the site of coupling for current reduction is made. Here an attempt is made to combine solar and wind generation stations with modular UPQC to enhance power quality issues of concern. Simulations were performed in MATLAB/SIMULINK.

articleTitle: Collision Avoidance of Mobile Robot Using Successive Convexification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced & Global Engineering Challenges (AGEC)
abstract: Obstacle avoidance of mobile robot is solved using Successive convexification. Non-linear dynamics and non-convex control constraints of mobile robot make the control problem challenging. Collision avoidance of mobile robot is important to avoid physical harms. Obstacle avoidance of mobile robot has received widespread attention. Successive convexification is used to avoid the obstacles placed at different locations for mobile robot. This is successful in avoiding obstacles of arbitrary shapes. Intelligent and autonomous robot is required for obstacle avoidance in uncertain environment. Successive convexification is applied for the control of mobile robot avoiding cylindrical obstacles placed at different locations.

articleTitle: Simulation of Switched Capacitor-Based Five-Level Inverter with PDPWM Control Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced & Global Engineering Challenges (AGEC)
abstract: This article presented the switched capacitor-based five-level inverter using the PDPWM control technique. The inverter has the ability to boost the DC-DC voltage using the switched capacitor function. A unique composite structure cuts the number of components in relation to traditional multilevel inverter topologies. The occurring switching losses can be reduced by operating some switches at main voltage frequencies. As a result, switched-capacitor circuits are used to unlock the possibilities for power density and system efficiency. More ever, the control technique employs an improved carrier-based phase disposition pulse width modulation scheme. The output waveform quality may be substantially enhanced with this control technique, and the capacitor voltages are self-balanced. The MATLAB Simulink of the proposed five-level inverter shows the analysis and performance of the inverter.

articleTitle: Review of Performance Analysis of Some Basic Full Adder Circuits
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced & Global Engineering Challenges (AGEC)
abstract: A basic building block of VLSI circuits and systems is a Full Adder (FA) Circuit. A FA circuit is the central digital circuit that performs addition. It is an important component of VLSI circuits and systems. A complete adder circuit can be designed in a variety of ways. The major goal of this is to investigate the performance of some F As such as CMOS, CPL, TGA, and HYBRID circuits. P (Power), D (Delay), PDP (Power Delay Product), and EDP (Energy Delay Product) are the various performance parameters. Performance comparisons are also conducted. It is observed that CMOS is a robust design, CPL is the worst design, TGA has better performance as compared to CMOS and CPL, whereas hybrid FA has the best performance in the gdk 130nm Technology node. Mentor Graphics EDA (Electronic Design Automatic) Tool is used for all simulation.

articleTitle: Dual-Mode OAM Beam UCA Antenna with Beam Divergence Reduction Capability Using PLA Lens
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced & Global Engineering Challenges (AGEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a 3D printable polylactic acid (PLA) lens to reduce the beam divergence of dual-mode OAM beams generated by a uniform circular array (UCA) at 5.9 GHz. The lens is placed in front of the UCA to modify the phase of the OAM beam, which results in a reduction of beam divergence. The UCA generates OAM modes <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$l=+1$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$l=+2$</tex> by providing input excitation to the individual feed network. The effectiveness of the PLA lens is compared to the UCA antenna with and without the lens in terms of the radiation pattern, <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$S_{11}$</tex>, electric field amplitude, and phase pattern. The radiation pattern of the OAM beam with the PLA lens exhibits a more focused and narrower beam than the OAM beam generated without the lens. The proposed PLA lens could be used in future OAM-based communication systems to reduce beam divergence and improve communication range.

articleTitle: Time Series Analysis of Impact of Covid-19 Using Facebook Prophet Model and Review of the Machine-Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced & Global Engineering Challenges (AGEC)
abstract: The covid-19 pandemic has affected the entire world both financially and with loss of precious human life. This pandemic situation is not a new scenario as these kind of pandemic situations has affected us in past typically once in a century. Analysis the trend of covid-19 will helps us in understanding the requirement of the need to overcome this situation and it can used as a reference to tackle future pandemic of this kind. In this paper, the time series analysis of covid-19 is performed using facebook prophet model and the study of machine learning algorithm for covid-19 is performed. Facebook prophet model is a machine-learning algorithm introduced by facebook, which is very useful algorithm in predicting the future values for the time series data. In this article analysis of covid-19 data is carried out using Support Vector Machine (SVM), Random forest and Catboost algorithms and its results is studied followed by the time series analysis using facebook prophet model.

articleTitle: Spectral Wave Energy of Tsunami Waves Over the Visakhapatnam Port
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced & Global Engineering Challenges (AGEC)
abstract: The ocean is an excellent wave energy source, and utilizing this energy could have substantial benefits, but tsunami waves cause large-scale harm along the coastal region and destroy the coastal structures. The precise prediction of the wave energy distribution during regular day waves and Tsunami waves is essential. It is useful in utilizing wave energy and taking preventive measures to safeguard coastal structures from devastating waves. The mathematical model is demonstrated to predict the accurate distribution of wave energy due to regular day waves and tsunami waves arriving from the northeast and southeast directional waves inside the Visakhapatnam port. The present formulation is verified by comparing the simulations with the previous study. The four key locations are selected to investigate distributions of spectral wave energy within Visakhapatnam port with variable depth and partially reflecting boundary. Thus, the proposed mathematical model is an efficient technique to determine the distribution of wave energy during regular day waves and the tsunami waves at Visakhapatnam port. The sources and mitigation strategies are advised to minimize the wave hazard of regular day waves and the tsunami waves.

articleTitle: Design of Electric Vehicle Model with a Dynamo Drive Setup Using Model-Based Development (MDB)
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced & Global Engineering Challenges (AGEC)
abstract: The increase in software content in today's electric vehicle increases attention for having vast unique topographies from low emission to high efficiency, whereas the chemical batteries have huge short comes such as limited cycle life, power density, and cost. As for understanding and visualization, the companies are turning toward the virtual vehicle to test their design in software which is known as a simulation in the loop (SIL). In this project, in addition to the electric vehicle (EV) technology, we are adding a dynamo with the vehicle for regenerative braking. Traditionally the principle of dynamos is used in lighting the purpose of the bicycle. Here by using the same mechanism we are running the vehicle as well as charging the vehicle from system-level simulation to the model in the loop and then to the Hardware in Loop (HIL) by using model-based development.

articleTitle: Wave Power Energy Trend Over the Indian Ocean during Monsoon Season
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced & Global Engineering Challenges (AGEC)
abstract: This study investigates the trends and variance of mean and extreme wave power energy (WPavg and WPmax) over the Indian Ocean (IO) during monsoon season (June-August; JJA). The analysis is based on ERA5 reanalysis datasets over the period 1980–2021. The north and tropical IO exhibit moderate increases in WPavg (60–90 kW/m) during the JJA season. However, pronounced increases in WPavg (~180 kW/m) are evident over the southern IO during JJA. A similar climatology pattern is reflected in WPmax, except for the strengthened intensity (upto 4 times). Further, regions with strong climatology exhibit substantial variability in the respective regions for both WPavg and WPmax. The most prominent rate of increase in WPavg is evident over the southern IO with r=0.28. While for WPmax, the most significant rate of increase is found in the tropical IO with r=0.62. Results highlight the region's ocean where wave power generation could provide beneficial outcomes to overcome the energy deficit problem over the Indian Ocean.

articleTitle: Visual Monitoring of Many Objects in Real Time Using Embedded GPU
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced & Global Engineering Challenges (AGEC)
abstract: In modern times, object tracking and detection play a crucial role in many real-life applications like the traffic sector, UAVs, and many other real-life applications. Generally, object detection and tracking have different approaches but we discuss a new approach in this article. Usually, object tracking and detection is a hard task it generally performs using AI and deep learning-based platforms so for that we require a heavy performance high-end hardware but previously we perform this task on low-power edge IoT devices but there are some drawbacks like limited computing and also compromising inaccuracy. So to improve the efficiency, accuracy, and performance we go for an embedded GPU platform which consists of a deep learning architecture and also the joint architecture of tracking and detection. By this combination system, the accuracy is increased on the MOT16 data set. And also the efficiency is increased to track the 45 simultaneous objects at a time with 25 fps.

articleTitle: Image Fusion Using Contrast-Enhanced Images Captured in Low Light and Infrared
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced & Global Engineering Challenges (AGEC)
abstract: Image fusion is a sub-branch of image processing. Generally, Fusion is defined as gathering or combining required information from multiple inputs and processing it into a single valid output. The process of image fusion includes sharpening and enhancing the images and their features, also brushing up its classification. This process not only provides accurate images and user- friendly but also decreases the amount of data. In dark light environments because of low contrast level and high noise level, it was very difficult for both the human and machine intelligence to perform effectively, to overcome this we go with image fusion. Techniques involved in this image processing are namely both frequency domain and spatial domain methods. In spatial domain approaches, PCA and Max-Min techniques are mostly used. In frequency domain techniques we concentrate more on discrete wavelet transform techniques. Image fusion is applied in the fields of surveillance field, medical, security, geo-spatial, and transport fields.

articleTitle: Reactive Power Coordination of 2MW and 3MW DDGs with ULTC and Shunt Capacitors
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced & Global Engineering Challenges (AGEC)
abstract: The deployment of 2MW and 3MW Dispatchable Distributed Generations (DDGs) has an impact on the switching operations of UL TC & Shunt Capacitors. Reactive power coordination between 2MW, 3MW DDGs and UL TC & Shunt Capacitors reduces UL TC & SC switching operations (SCs). This study proposes a novel reactive power scheduling approach that anticipates load one day in advance using an Adaptive Neuro Fuzzy Inference System (ANFIS) model. The Grey Wolf Optimizer (GWO) approach is recommended for solving the objective function, which is described as a combination of power loss and SOs, and it schedules the reactive power contribution of 2MW DDG, 3MW DDG, UL TC, and SCs. The proposed technique was developed in MATLAB and tested using 16 buses and a 10 kV system. When compared to traditional and particle swarm optimization (PSO) approaches, simulation results plainly reveal that this strategy achieves the goals without straying from the grid conditions.

articleTitle: A Reduced Switch Count Multilevel Inverter with Asymmetrical Sources
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced & Global Engineering Challenges (AGEC)
abstract: A nine-level asymmetrical inverter network topology with lesser quantity of switches and de sources is proposed in this work. This topology is developed from the combination of H-bridge and flying capacitor inverter structures. This topology has four dc sources, two dc sources are connected in inverse path w.r.t the other two. The proposed topology produces four positive and four negative voltage levels at the output, providing a voltage waveform at the load ports with nine discrete levels. The switches in the inverter are controlled using efficient sinusoidal PWM technique. In this manuscript, modulation technique and operating concept are broken down in depth. Also included are comprehensive displays of simulation outcomes for a range of modulation indices. The zero, positive, and negative states of the proposed inverter are analyzed. The last step is a simulation run in MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: BDCT-Blockchain-Based Decentralized Computing and Tamper Resistance for Cloud Storage
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced & Global Engineering Challenges (AGEC)
abstract: The introduction of the mobile-cloud environment pattern has enabled devices with insufficient dispensation battery lives to do complex tasks. They have limited resources to address the difficulties that exist in existing models that are based on strong assumptions and resource validations. Furthermore, sending data and code to an untrusted platform raises security concerns, and achieving total protection is challenging due to the complexity added by more optimization approaches. In this BDCT study, we describe a dynamic mobile-cloud computing system based on secure blockchain-based tamper resistance storage. We propose a dynamic tamper-confrontation approach to security management that provides agents with self-protection capabilities through a low-overhead introspection and integrity-preserving communication mechanism.

articleTitle: Hydrogen Detection Using ZnO-Based Thin Film MEMS Integrated Sensor Chip
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced & Global Engineering Challenges (AGEC)
abstract: This work reports the development of a highly sensitive, selective hydrogen sensor chip utilizing ZnO-thin film integrated into the sensor platform along with an integrated microheater. The fabricated sensor chip is characterized and optimized to achieve a good sensor response to different exposed hydrogen concentrations in air. The selectivity check is studied in the presence of twelve other different interfering gases, i.e., Acetone, Ammonia, Carbon monoxide, Carbon dioxide, Ethelene, Ethyl alcohol, Hydrogen sulfide, Methane, Nitrogen oxide, Nitrogen dioxide, Oxygen, Sulfur dioxide, as these gases can affect the sensor performance in the indoor and outdoor application of hydrogen sensor. The repeatability check of sensor performance towards hydrogen detection is verified multiple times to understand the sensor response against each exposure of the interference gases. Moreover, a suitable combination of passive filters is used to improve the sensor performance further, which reduces the change of incoming air moisture around the sensor chip, improving the sensor's sensitivity towards the hydrogen gas. The main advantage of our sensor with the filter is that it can accurately detect hydrogen with interference gases at different RH conditions.

articleTitle: A Critical Review on Available Methods for Estimating the Present State-of-Charge of the Batteries Used in EV/HEV
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced & Global Engineering Challenges (AGEC)
abstract: Electric vehicles rely heavily on battery technology. So, it is very important to focus the research on battery design and state-of-charge valuation. In all types of batteries, Li-ion batteries are the efficient choice for electric vehicles because of their low self-discharge, high energy density, high charging and discharging cycles, and high voltage. But the lithium-ion batteries need regular monitoring. So, we need a battery management scheme to monitor the battery's concert. SOC estimation is a critical thing in the BMS that determines how much charge is left in the battery. To select the best method for creating a battery management system that operates reliably and safely, this review discusses the available methods of SOC approximation along with their significant benefits and drawbacks.

articleTitle: Survival Analysis of Heart Failure Patients Using Advanced Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced & Global Engineering Challenges (AGEC)
abstract: According to World health organization, the death rate due to cardiovascular Disease (CVD) globally touches an estimate of 17.9 million every year. It became very significant for the doctors to accurately predict the heart diseases and failures based on various clinical reports across multiple patient records. Machine learning and Deep Learning techniques made a larger impact in making timely decisions by the doctors to suggest appropriate medication based on prediction models there by controlling the death rate due to diseases associated due to heart failure. Artificial Intelligence (AI) techniques have been more popular in the recent times for accurate clinical diagnosis in health care. This paper mainly concentrates in identifying the best machine learning technique for generating a predictive conclusion of the rate of survival in heart disease victims. A dataset comprising of 303 samples with 14 attributes of heart disease patients is considered for the analysis The contribution mentioned in the paper is to analyze and evaluate the best prediction model for identifying flow in the heart failure. The machine learning models considered for evaluation and comparison are Decision Tree, Random Forest, XG Boost and Ada Boost. It is found that Logistic Regression exhibits an accuracy of 0.885, XGBoost and Decision Tree exhibits equal performance with an accuracy 0.8524.

articleTitle: Modelling of Residential Distribution System with Aid of Electric Vehicles for Improve the Voltage Profile
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced & Global Engineering Challenges (AGEC)
abstract: Electric vehicles offer an effective and tangible solution to reducing pollution, combating environmental change and thereby improving energy security. However, the potential for widespread EV adoption poses significant barriers to the operation of residential distribution systems, depending on how and when EVs are charged. This new mode of transport and infrastructure requires reliable and safe energy management solutions. It must be ensured that the electric vehicles and their charging infrastructure are safe, convenient, energy-efficient and economical for everyone involved. In addition, grid operators must ensure that they can easily control the charging and discharging of electric vehicles in the distribution grid. Certainly, when properly integrated, electric vehicles can bring benefits to both energy providers and their owners. In this article, we investigated bi-directional EV charging in a residential radial distribution system to improve the system's voltage profile by optimizing EV charging and discharging. The Radial Residential Distribution System is simulated in MATLAB 2016a with different scenarios and the results are presented.

articleTitle: Mitigation of Cross Coupling Effects in Series Configuration of PV D-MPPT Architecture with SEPIC Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced & Global Engineering Challenges (AGEC)
abstract: Photo-Voltaic systems consisting of long strings are prone to shading effects which result in a decrease in the total power output of the system. The promising solution to this problem is Distributed Maximum Power Point Tracking (D-MPPT) technique where each Photo Voltaic unit is attached to its respective DC-DC converter. Generally, there are two types of D-MPPT architectures: Parallel for high current and series for high voltage applications. There have been some exceptions in the system when the units are joined in series under situations of partial shade. Cross Coupling Effects (CCE) is a term used to describe such exceptions. The coupling effects have been seen with the use of a boost converter. When it is replaced by a SEPIC converter CCE is eliminated, and optimum use of the system can be seen.

articleTitle: Estimation of Relaxation Time Using Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy of Graphitic Carbon Nitride-Based Supercapacitor
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced & Global Engineering Challenges (AGEC)
abstract: This work explains the impact of different electrochemical analyses, especially electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS), towards the identification of essential parameters for energy storage applications. The EIS analysis of supercapacitors devices comprising graphitic carbon nitride (g-C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>) based electrode materials is described here to realize different equivalent circuit models and estimate the relaxation time offered by the electrode materials. The supercapacitive charge storage phenomenon is influenced by different parts of existing supercapacitor devices, and the proper amalgamation and optimization of these parts will enrich the overall charge storage behaviors of the entire supercapacitor device. A simple facile, cost-effective synthesis process was adopted to synthesize g-<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>, and distinct electrolytes were used to explain the effect of proper electrode/electrolyte interfaces to estimate the various essential parameters, especially relaxation time. This study reveals that the electrode materials composed of g-<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> offer acceptable relaxation time, thus showing immense potential for designing various binary and ternary nanocomposites based on g-<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> for supercapacitor applications.

articleTitle: Design and Emulation of Solar Panel Output Power Characteristics Using Arduino
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced & Global Engineering Challenges (AGEC)
abstract: Solar energy is used more frequently now for home, industrial and commercial purposes. A renewable resource solar energy is created from the sun's heat. The installed solar capacity in India was 34,627 Megawatts in 2020. An experimental set-up for measuring the power of solar panels was established in this paper. Voltage and light intensity in this current have been measured. The sun's declination angle with Earth is +23.5°, -23.5°. An High Heat Bulb light is used to simulate the sun, with the angles carefully adjusted. This paper describes solar power output at the load side and illustrates how power and load resistance vary. By applying High heat light bulb light intensity to solar panels, power is produced. A voltage regulator was used to control the brightness of the light. Solar power attempts to simulate the power production of real solar panels. The sun rays irradiation is converted into an High Heat Bulb light and placed on a rotating iron track facing towards both the eastern and western horizons. simply repositioning the bulb and adjusting the D.C. speed regulator, you can change the light's intensity. Power is calculated by taking the measurements from the voltmeter and ammeter. Resistance versus power, are plotted on a graph. The focus of this study is on maximizing power output during load, here represented by a resistor bank.

articleTitle: Analysis and Improvement of the Power Quality in Grid Integrated to Distributed Generation (Solar PV System) Using UPQC
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced & Global Engineering Challenges (AGEC)
abstract: Increased power-electronic-based non-linear loads will affect the distribution network's ability to produce and use high-quality power under the current circumstances. Now a day's identification of problems is more crucial in the electricity system. The main factors like voltage sag and voltage swell are affecting the quality of power for connecting a non-linear load to the system. The proposed system aims to assess the grid's power quality issues caused by distributed photovoltaic generation while also computing the Total harmonic Distortion (THD). In the proposed system, the Unified Power Quality Conditioner (UPQC) based Artificial Neural Network (ANN) controller is used to alleviate power quality issues and lower THD levels. When Compare to all conventional controllers the proposed method will gives better results. Using the MATLAB/SIMULINK software, the UPQC will be designed with the Vector Template Generation (VTG) and park transformation theory with MPPT technique in the shunt part for generating the signals.

articleTitle: Hybrid Energy Initiative for University Campus: A Techno-Economic Case Study
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced & Global Engineering Challenges (AGEC)
abstract: For several techno-economic and environmental benefits, grid connected hybrid microgrid is a prudent choice for upgradation of an existing conventional system. So, in this paper, a grid connected Hybrid Microgrid System (HMGS) is proposed for “The Neotia University (TNU), West Bengal, India” to extract maximum benefit. Presently, the University's load demands are fulfilled by mainly conventional grid and Diesel Generator (DG) set (during power outage). In this proposed microgrid system, Photovoltaic (PV) panels & Wind Turbines (WT) are also considered for inclusion in addition to the existing system. To get maximum benefits and reliability, choosing the optimal number of PV panels & WTs is very important. For this selection, an advanced and well proven Grey Wolf Optimization (GWO) algorithm has been applied here. The main objective of this case study is to reduce overall expenditure on electricity bills, which in turn reduces the Cost of Energy (COE) without compromising the system reliability.

articleTitle: Heart Disease Prediction Using Different Boosting Models
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced & Global Engineering Challenges (AGEC)
abstract: Nowadays, heart disease (HD) is one of the leading causes of death. The detection of HD is required at an early stage in order to diagnose it beforehand. The traditional method for the detection of HD is becoming more challenging and time-consuming. It is also not available in many healthcare facilities. To overcome this issue, machine learning is an alternative and sophisticated tool. For this purpose, we used five boosting methods, namely Adaptive Boosting (AB), Gradient Boosting (GB), Categorical Boosting (CB), Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGB), and Light Gradient Boosting Machine (LGBM) to predict HD on the UCI Cleveland HD dataset to get the best possible result. After the comparative study of five models, we found that the AB and XGB models are best in accuracy (≈ 93 percent), precision (0.94), recall (0.93), and Fl-Scores (0.93). The accuracy value is equal to that of the recently reported ensemble technique and greater than the accuracy of 91.8 percent of a stacking classifier in the same dataset.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Circular Microstrip Patch Array Antenna for 5G Communication Using Rogers RT5880
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced & Global Engineering Challenges (AGEC)
abstract: The significance of communication equipment is to attain high accuracy with miniature size. In this research, an array of circular microstrip patch antennas (CMPAs) is designed for future 5G mobile data networks applications and it is suitable for 5G technology with mm wave antenna systems. The resonance frequency of the proposed antenna is 28 GHz and it is constructed using a Rogers RT5880 substrate with a <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\epsilon_{\mathrm{r}}$</tex> 2.2, a loss tangent of 0.0013, and a height of 0.508 mm. Patch with diameter 2.02 mm and substrate with size 8.08×8.08 mm-, Here it is shown the miniature antenna with minimal return loss and high gain. Using HFSS Software the simulated results are S11 = -16.2dB, gain is 7.5dB obtained for a single circular antenna, return loss = -18.5dB, gain is 8.8dB for a two-array antenna, return loss = -21.6dB, gain is 9.6dB for a four-array antenna.

articleTitle: Analysis of Critical Issues in Retrofitting of IC Vehicles to Electric Vehicle: A Technical Review
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced & Global Engineering Challenges (AGEC)
abstract: The retrofitting of Internal Combustion (IC) vehicles to Electric Vehicles (EV s) has gained significant attention due to the increasing demand for sustainable and environmentally friendly transportation solutions. Retrofitting of IC vehicles to EVs involves replacing the combustion engine with an electric motor and batteries, which requires careful consideration of various technical and practical issues. This paper presents a technical review of the critical issues that need to be considered when retrofitting IC vehicles to EVs. The paper covers a range of technical issues, The paper covers a range of technical issues, including compatibility, performance and support systems. The practical issues related to retrofitting, such as cost and regulatory requirements, are also discussed. In addition, the paper provides an overview of the current state of retrofitting technology and its limitations. The review aims to provide a comprehensive understanding of the challenges and opportunities associated with retrofitting IC vehicles to EVs and to help guide future research and development in this field.

articleTitle: Analysis of IoT Based System for Flood Monitoring Application
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced & Global Engineering Challenges (AGEC)
abstract: The one of the utmost public types of natural disaster is floods, which can happen anywhere in the world. There must be a system in place to deal with flooding if a region or country is at risk of being flooded. The field of flood management has benefited greatly from the application of IT in recent years. For instance, in many parts of the world, Hydrological data, such as water level, can be easily gathered by sensors and transmitted via the internet at this point. Measurement and communication of meteorological and geological information relating to floods is similarly important. Collectively, these components constitute meaning of the “Internet of Things” (IoT). This paper offers a summary of the literature on flood data management projects that employ IoT. The study then proposes an IoT architecture for flood information management to ease the rollout of equipment that collects, transmits, and manages data relevant to floods.

articleTitle: Liver Disease Prediction Using Different Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced & Global Engineering Challenges (AGEC)
abstract: The liver is a vital organ in the human body since it is in charge of metabolism, detoxification, storage, digestion, blood sugar regulation, and immunological function. As a result, any harm or dysfunction to it can result in serious illness. Hence, early detection of it provides effective treatment, prevents further damage, cost-effective, and overall increases the survival rate of a particular individual. In this paper, we have taken the BUPA Liver Disease (LD) dataset from the UCI repository. We worked with several machine learning algorithms (MLAs) such as Decision Tree (DT), K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Multilayer Perceptron (MLP), Adaptiveptive Boosting (AB), Random Forest (RF), Gradient Boosting (GB), Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGB), Logistic Regression (LR), Gaussian Naive Bayes (NB), Extra Tree (ET), Light Gradient-Boosting Machine (LGBM), and Support Vector Machine (SVM). After applying these twelve methods, we made predictions about the possibility of having the liver disease or not. Here, we have found DT to be the best among the twelve algorithms with accuracy, precision, recall, and Fl-Score of 86.67%, 0.87, 0.87, and 0.86, respectively.

articleTitle: Feasibility Study of Stand-Alone Solar PV Powered Desalination Plant at Yarada, Visakhapatnam
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced & Global Engineering Challenges (AGEC)
abstract: Rapid urbanization in India has caused a strain on the government's ability to provide solutions for water scarcity. India is a significant grain producer but also has a high demand for water due to the industries that have emerged from the “Make in India” initiative. To address the water crisis, the government has promoted awareness of water conservation, rainwater harvesting, wastewater treatment, and the maintenance of taps. Desalination, which removes salt from seawater, could also be a viable solution to freshwater issues. India has a long coastline, and desalination plants could be built along it to provide a source of freshwater. The article aims to investigate the feasibility of building a solar PV-powered desalination plant at Yarada, Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, India, and to understand the financial and technical requirements for establishing such a plant. The study considers different ratings for both desalination plants and solar PV modules available in the Indian market and uses life cycle cost calculations and payback period analysis to evaluate the financial requirements for installing the plant.

articleTitle: A Neural Network for License Plate Detection and Recogntion
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced & Global Engineering Challenges (AGEC)
abstract: This paper presents the information about the vehicle plate detection and recognition with the character segmentation. This system depends on YOLO for detection and Optical Character Recognition (OCR) for segmentation process. YOLO is a method that provides real-time object detection using neural networks. The popularity of this algorithm is due to its accuracy and quickness. This system evaluates the different models of license plate and aims to improve the accuracy or speed at each and every stage of process. The implementation of Convolutional Neutral Network (CNN) gives more accurate and effective results for detection and segmentation stages. CNN is trained for Vehicle License Plate Recognition (VLPR) to get more accurate results in different conditions (like poor-lightening conditions) CNN gives the detected and rectified vehicle license plate images. Optical Character recognition is capable for recognizes the numbers as well as characters in detected image. By using YOLO, CNN and OCR the experimental results are very accurate without any adaption, it outperforms the detection and recognition of license plate is very accurate and provides the enhancement images and converted text format data as a final output. When compared to state-of-the-arts, the suggested YOLO architecture performs well with a licence plate identification accuracy of 98.7%.

articleTitle: Analysis of Axle Counter Performance: A Case Study of Kolkata Metro Railway
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced & Global Engineering Challenges (AGEC)
abstract: These days Metro Railway is one for the cheapest, ecofriendly Rapid Transit System to overcome the congestion on roadways. Among its different subsystems, axle counter is regarded as an integral part of signaling system and used to identify occupancy of track by trains and thus, its failure hampers the movement of train. This suggests that there is a need to analyze its pattern of failure and estimate its availability. The overall equipment effectiveness (OEE) based on availability, performance and quality has been calculated for 15 months each of these. It is studied that mean of OEE is about 75% and variation is 10% approximately over the period of time. Keeping these issues in mind, this paper also analyzes the Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability of axle counters failures for metro railway systems.

articleTitle: Computer Navigation and Control Using BCI
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced & Global Engineering Challenges (AGEC)
abstract: The project introduces a novel approach to computer navigation and control using Brain-Computer Interfaces (BCI). BCI enables individuals to interact with computers using their brainwaves, offering a new way of smartly interacting with technology. The work presents a new concept that is designed to help individuals with physical disabilities use computers more easily. The Electroencephalogram (EEG) technology is utilized to record the brainwave patterns and detect signals associated with movement. This allows the user to operate their computer using their eye movements. Eye movement is a crucial real-time input medium for human-computer communication, especially for people with physical disabilities. The Emotive EEG headset, which consists of five electrodes, records electrical signals from different regions of the brain. These signals are processed using EEGLAB to preprocess and extract events, and then classified using a Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) network, trained using Scaled Conjugate Gradient (SCG) optimization. The project also includes a motor imagery experiment, which involves the user imagining the movement of their limbs while their EEG signals are recorded. The signals are then processed and classified using the aforementioned methods to provide control commands to the computer. The EEG technology's portability and ease of use make it a promising option for researchers and individuals interested in exploring the potential of BCI technology. The proposed approach has the potential to provide a more accessible and efficient way of computer navigation and control for individuals with physical disabilities. In summary, this project introduces a new concept for computer navigation and control using BCI and EEG technology. The inclusion of a motor imagery experiment and the use of machine learning techniques to classify EEG signals make this project an exciting contribution to the field of BCI research.

articleTitle: Identification and Classification of Crop Diseases Using Transfer Learning Based Convolution Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced & Global Engineering Challenges (AGEC)
abstract: Pests and diseases can have a major impact on the apple industry. Apple crops are susceptible to a range of diseases that can do a lot of harm to the fruit and the trees, reducing yields and affecting the quality of the apples. This, in turn, leads to lower revenues for growers and a higher cost of production. The symptoms of different apple diseases can sometimes be similar, making it difficult for farmers to accurately diagnose the problem and choose the appropriate treatment. In some cases, multiple diseases can occur simultaneously, further complicating the diagnosis and management of the problem. To overcome this challenge, an initiative is conceptualized to provide a quick and precise apple disease detection and classification. In this paper, a deep learning based approach for classifying and identifying apple diseases has been proposed wherein the generated dataset is fed into a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model which comprises the object identification (for locating & identifying objects of interest in an image), segmentation (for separating the objects from the background), and image classification (for assigning each object to a specific class or category). Further data augmentation methods including scaling, rotation, reflection were also incorporated for better learning of underlying patterns in the data, leading to improved generalization and reduced over-fitting. The proposed CNN method achieved impressive results, scoring about 97.06 % accuracy as well as better score for other evaluating metrics, such as precision, recall, or F1-score. Therefore, by using a CNN model to accurately diagnose different apple diseases, farmers can make informed decisions about how to manage their crops, leading to improved yields and higher revenues.
